question: Can the per-prompt dR probe (zero generated tokens, refusal-only R800 corpus) replace two-sided BR as the search screen for the 800-row check?
method: lnPPL(R800-sub128) vs base, control corpus skipped (see confound 2)
why_it_fails: ordering inverted vs known branch damage (oracle must top a branch meter; our tone-only arm tops instead)
R800 continuations include base pivot/lecture prose: dR tracks style-distance from base answer form, not refusal-branch damage
control corpus does not cancel this: the confound is corpus-STYLE-specific, not global drift (banked control drift <=0.006)
incidental: 12 of 16 arms errored 'no PPL line' because the ladder invoked stale q3-4b-*-q8.gguf paths; the fitted arms on disk are the -l935 variants. Bookkeeping error, not a probe fault; the four that ran suffice to falsify the single-sided screen.
what_stands: two-sided BR on the hand-read delivery-pair corpus (oracle +0.559, oaxes135 +0.649, all fitted arms ~0) remains the only validated zero-generated-token screen; refusal800.txt survives as the amortized refusal-reference for style/collapse checks only (negative dR = branch strengthened still reads correctly there).
